thread:
maria: Heads up — ap-south1 GPU queues just spiked ~3x over the last 12m. Per-model backlog snapshot from the queue service: mosaic-4b: 1,200, mosaic-xl: 90, redwood-qa: 450, embed-small: 1,400. P99 gen latency creeping above 6s for several models. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/c/queues/ap-south1 (view restricted)

alex: Can you paste the admission config + any recent route changes? Any infra deploys in the last hour? :eyes:

maria: No infra deploys per deploy-bot. Product rolled a non-prod routing tweak ~18m ago. Pasting current admission snippet below:

```yaml
admission:
  global_qps: 2000
  per_model_limits:
    mosaic-4b: 50
    mosaic-xl: 20
    embed-small: 100
priority_classes:
  realtime: p1
  low: p3
```

sam: Embed-small looks like the biggest contributor to queue pressure. Routing weights show embed-small had a +20% weight to ap-south1 after that product change. Suggest temporary hard cap for embed-small to 60, and enable cross-zone spillover to ap-southeast1 if capacity allows.

julia: AP-southeast1 has spare pods but hybrid spillover for embed-small wasn't whitelisted. Opsbot, can you check capacity and apply spillover if safe?

opsbot: Checked capacity: aps1 spare GPU pods = 12 (est throughput ~480 rps for embed-small). Whitelisting rules: mosaic-4b and embed-small added to cross-zone spillover allowlist. Initiating spillover policy now.

deploy-bot: Route update applied: canary redirect 30% of embed-small traffic to aps2. config_id=route-9876

alex: Also propose immediate token-level throttles for non-prod/dev customers. If we flip dev* -> 5 qps per token at the ingress rate-limiter we should knock out a big chunk of noisy traffic. Can ops push that?

maria: On it. Patching rate-limiter rule: dev* -> 5 qps/token. Also temporarily raising mosaic-4b pslots from 50 -> 80 for 10m to avoid in-flight failures while we clear the backlog.

sam: Monitoring shows embed-small queue decreasing ~30% after the canary. Mosaic-4b still has long tail — looks like several 60s+ generation sessions from a small token cohort (likely a customer regression). Pulling logs to identify tokens.

maria: Found 3 runaway sessions, manually killed them and evicted 9 low-priority pslots. Triggered rebalancer: `./rebalancer --region ap-south1 --evict-low-priority --dryrun=false`.

opsbot: Rebalancer started at 1729123600. Estimated recovery: 6-8 minutes. Alerts suppressed for 30m to avoid noise.

maria: Queue depth trending down. Will keep throttles & spillover in place for 20m and then roll back if stable. Filing a follow-up incident note once we confirm. Thanks for the quick responses :heart:

alex: Please add a follow-up to check routing weight rollback and to add a guardrail: alert if per-model routing weight delta > 10% in 5m window.

julia: +1 to that guardrail. Also let's add a post-mortem item: model-level canary should not change routing weight across regions without ops ack.

maria: Copy. Closing thread if stable — I'll post an update in 30m.
